title: Rationale for Adjusting Buyer's Stamp Duty Rates for Higher-value Properties
what_it_is: Rationale for Adjusting Buyer's Stamp Duty Rates for Higher-value Properties

sections.label: BSD transitional provision conditions
sections.summary: The transitional provision and its three conditions mirror past BSD and ABSD adjustments, with appeals possible to IRAS for extenuating circumstances.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The transitional provision and its three conditions are similar to those implemented for the Budget 2018 BSD rate adjustments, and past Additional Buyer’s Stamp Duty or ABSD, rate adjustments.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: These conditions are designed to ensure that the prior BSD rates apply only to pre-existing Options to Purchase or OTPs, that are granted on or before 14 February 2023, even though they are exercised shortly later.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: There is a condition that the OTP should not be varied on or after 15 February 2023 to minimise gaming by buyers hoping to circumvent the revised BSD rates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Buyers who are unable to fulfil the conditions of the transitional provision due to extenuating circumstances may submit an appeal to the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (IRAS).

sections.label: Variation and IRAS appeals
sections.summary: Parties may appeal to IRAS, which considers flexibility and has done so for most appeal cases received.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
sentences.text: So, perhaps, the Senior Minister of State can confirm, if the terms of variation do not go to the root of the avoidance of the Stamp Duty, can parties still proceed with the variation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: So, for this kind of situations, as I mentioned in my main reply, they can submit an appeal to IRAS and IRAS will consider if there is justification to provide flexibility.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: IRAS has done so for the majority of appeal cases it received so far.

sections.label: OTP exercise timing conditions
sections.summary: The conditions provide that the OTP is exercised on or before 7 March, or within the validity period, whichever is earlier.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Mr Lim is not asking about the duration.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We do provide some time in the conditions that the OTP is exercised on or before 7 March, or within the validity period, whichever is earlier.

sections.label: Case-by-case IRAS flexibility
sections.summary: Detailed situations cannot be spelled out upfront as they are case by case, but genuine minor changes can be surfaced to IRAS for consideration.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: I hope the Members, both Assoc Prof Jamus Lim and Mr Lim Biow Chuan understand why it is very difficult for us to spell out upfront what are all the detailed situations, because it is going to be case by case.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: But as I had given Mr Lim the assurance, if there are genuine cases and the changes are not major, they are minor changes, do surface to IRAS and IRAS will consider if there are justifications to provide flexibility.
